bugs.name: Changing project state filter clears the search query
bugs.summary: Switching between open and closed repository projects drops the active search query.
bugs.expected: Changing the project state retains the submitted search query.
bugs.actual: On two repeated transitions, selecting Closed after searching for a fresh Alpha project navigated to state=closed&q= and displayed an unrelated closed Beta project.
reproSteps: Create an open project named E2E Search Alpha and a closed project named E2E Search Beta in a disposable repository.
Open Projects, search for E2E Search Alpha and confirm the matching open project appears.
Select Closed; the URL has an empty q and the unrelated Beta project appears.

reviewedVariants.name: Project search and sort actions clear each other's state
reviewedVariants.summary: Searching and sorting each clear the other state: search removes sort=oldest, while selecting Oldest clears the active project query, so the filtered list cannot retain the chosen sort.
reviewedVariants.expected: The project query and selected sort should remain applied together: changing sort should preserve the query, and searching should preserve the selected sort, so users can filter and order the same result set.
reviewedVariants.actual: Using the two test-owned projects, search followed by Enter produced URL /momentic-admin/-/projects?state=open&q=mo-owner-projects-sort-oldest-mom-6d2f8ac1, with the query active and no sort parameter. Selecting Oldest then changed the URL to /momentic-admin/-/projects?q=&sort=oldest&state=open, cleared the query, and restored all 24 open projects. In the reverse sequence, Oldest was present in the URL, but submitting the search again removed the sort parameter and returned the two results. The input displayed the Search projects placeholder after submission, and the Sort control/menu showed no visible selected-item indicator; the URL established which state remained active.
reproSteps: Start signed in to the momentic-admin owner profile as admin@momentic.example using the supplied authenticated session; do not change account details.

Navigate to /momentic-admin/-/projects. Use the two projects created for this investigation: mo-owner-projects-sort-oldest-mom-6d2f8ac1-first and mo-owner-projects-sort-oldest-mom-6d2f8ac1-second; do not edit or delete them.

Sequence 1 — search, then sort: enter mo-owner-projects-sort-oldest-mom-6d2f8ac1 in Search projects and press Enter. Confirm the URL is /momentic-admin/-/projects?state=open&q=mo-owner-projects-sort-oldest-mom-6d2f8ac1 and only the two projects are shown. Open Sort and select Oldest. Confirm the URL changes to /momentic-admin/-/projects?q=&sort=oldest&state=open, the input returns to its Search projects placeholder, and the page shows all 24 open projects.

Sequence 2 — sort, then search: with sort=oldest active and q empty, enter the same project prefix in Search projects and press Enter. Confirm the URL returns to /momentic-admin/-/projects?state=open&q=mo-owner-projects-sort-oldest-mom-6d2f8ac1 with only the two projects shown and no sort parameter. The Sort control still reads Sort and the menu has no visible selected-item indicator.

bugs.name: Saving a project column leaves the edit dialog open without confirmation
bugs.summary: Editing a personal-project column saves the change behind the modal but leaves the edit form open. The only exit offered alongside the still-active save button is Cancel, although the change has already persisted.
bugs.expected: After a successful save, dismiss the edit dialog or display a clear saved confirmation so the user can return to the board and knows the edit completed.
bugs.actual: The column name changes on the board, but the Edit column dialog remains open with no success feedback. Cancel closes it, and reloading confirms the supposedly cancelled edit was saved. Reproduced with QA Review → QA Reviewed and QA Reviewed → QA Final Review.
reproSteps: Sign in as momentic-admin and open /momentic-admin/-/projects.
Create a project with the Basic kanban template and open its board (existing qa-personal-project at /momentic-admin/-/projects/1 also reproduces).
Open a column's menu and choose Edit column.
Change its name and click Edit column.
Wait for the board's column name to update; observe the dialog remains open. Click Cancel and reload the board.

reviewedVariants.name: Saving a project column leaves the edit dialog open
reviewedVariants.summary: A successful project column rename updates the board, but its Edit column modal remains open and prevents board navigation until Cancel is clicked.
reviewedVariants.expected: After a successful Edit column save, close the dialog and return to the updated project board.
reviewedVariants.actual: The column heading updates to Org Ready Parent Verified, while the dialog and its Cancel/Edit column buttons remain visible. Agent verified two renames and parent independently reproduced the same behavior.
reproSteps: Sign in and open an organization project board with a custom column, e.g. /bugbash-org/-/projects/2.
Open the custom column's dropdown and choose Edit column.
Change the Name to a new value.
Click the Edit column button in the dialog.
Observe the column heading changes behind the still-open dialog; Cancel must be clicked to return to the board.

bugs.name: Invalid column color silently fails with a server error
bugs.summary: Creating a project column with an invalid color dismisses the form, discards the entered name and color, and returns to the unchanged board without any validation message. The form submission returns HTTP 500.
bugs.expected: Validate the color and keep the form open with a clear error so the user can correct it.
bugs.actual: The dialog disappears, no column is created, and no error is displayed. Reopening shows an empty form. The POST to the project board returns 500. Reproduced at both 390px and 1280px viewport widths.
reproSteps: Sign in and open a personal project board, e.g. /momentic-admin/-/projects/1 (qa-personal-project).
Click New column.
Enter a nonempty name such as qa-invalid-color and enter not-a-color in Color.
Click Create column.
Observe the board and reopen New column.

bugs.name: Whitespace-only project, milestone, and label names are accepted
bugs.summary: Required name fields accept spaces and persist visually nameless projects, milestones and labels.
bugs.expected: Reject required names that are blank after trimming and ask for a visible name.
bugs.actual: Submitting spaces as the name creates and persists projects, milestones and labels whose names render blank. Label selectors consequently contain an unnamed option.
reproSteps: Sign in and open /momentic-admin/-/projects; click New project.
Enter three spaces in Title and create the project. Reload the project list.
Open /momentic-admin/field-notes/milestones/new; enter three spaces in Title and create the milestone. Inspect the milestone list.
Open /momentic-admin/field-notes/labels; click New label, enter three spaces in Name, and create the label. Inspect the label list and an issue's Labels selector.

matchingGuidance.acceptanceScope: Only the core failure described in this reference is accepted; the stronger original subclaims remain unestablished.
